articles.headline: Sport on ESPN in Africa this festive - What to watch on DStv, Disney+ in December
articles.description: From Thanksgiving NFL showdowns, to Christmas Day NBA action, and Boxing Day football, ESPN Africa has the festive season covered with a packed line-up of live sport, on channels across the continent and Disney+ in SA.

articles.headline: Ajax's Thilo Kehrer using his success to help Burundi's children
